text:
Carmen: Mistral POC reporting regression in first-token latency after a short load spike at ~09:05 PT. p50 normally ~150ms, spiking to 700-1200ms intermittently.
Liu: hosted or dedicated?
Carmen: hosted trial org. They enabled prefill to improve demo boot and used a tight batch window.
ops-bot: runtime v2.13.5 deployed to us-east-1 at 08:50 PT. No infra alerts.
Grant: what's their prefill config and client concurrency?
Carmen: customer pasted: `prefill: enabled, prefill_batch_window_ms: 160, max_prefill_tokens: 512`, concurrency ~18, model `redwood-2-8b-quant`.
Liu: did they see 429s?
Carmen: short 429 spike during the stress run, then later latency spikes.
Grant: ask them to run session diag: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/diag/session/<sid>?fields=queue,kvcache,rate` and paste excerpt.
Carmen: returned snippet: `queue_wait_ms=432, kvcache_hit=false, backend_ms=87, x-ratelimit-remaining=54`.
Liu: kvcache_hit=false + high queue_wait -> likely prefill write/read contention across shards. Small batch windows with many concurrent clients create KV thrash.
Grant: mitigation: 1) disable prefill to check baseline, 2) increase prefill_batch_window_ms to 900-1200ms, 3) enable prefill_strict_sequencing to serialize prefill per session.
Carmen: customer worried about demo SLA (p50 < 300ms) and asked if we can credit POC days affected.
sales-ops: we can provisionally offer a one-day hosted credit if after guided config changes and a 24h monitor the instability persists. Need deal owner sign-off.
Liu: quick test plan: A) disable prefill and replay the same burst for 3-5 minutes, B) if p50 recovers, re-enable with `prefill_batch_window_ms=1000` while we watch kvcache hit-rate and per-shard queue_wait_ms.
Carmen: customer did disable test and reported p50 ~230ms, no 429s over 6 mins.
Grant: that confirms prefill interaction. We'll schedule a controlled re-enable TOM 09:30 PT with infra on watch. Include API patch in email: `PATCH /v1/projects/<proj>/settings { "prefill": { "enabled": true, "prefill_batch_window_ms": 1000, "prefill_strict_sequencing": false } }`.
Liu: also ask them to capture `x-ratelimit-*` headers if they see errors. Follow-ups: ["monitor kvcache hit-rate during re-enable","capture per-shard queue_wait_ms","verify no 429s and record x-ratelimit headers","prepare quick rollback to disable prefill"]
ops-bot: note added to ticket #9801: "Temp prefill disable improved p50 to ~230ms. Planned controlled re-enable TOM 09:30 PT. Sales-ops credit pending." 
Carmen: I'll draft the customer email and invite infra for the re-enable call. Thanks team :thumbsup:
